systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with WHO support

note: Read whole. WHO says that in 2025 a phased optimisation of DHIS2 set up national servers, standardised data elements, enhanced interoperability across HIV, maternal health, surveillance, NCD and immunisation programmes and trained 21 super users, and that a Strategic Information Department Strategic Plan 2024-2028 was developed; it never says what DHIS2 collects or who enters it, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
